Ayuda.title: Help Center
Ayuda.subtitle: Resolve your doubts and find support for the SIG Quotations System.
Ayuda.docsItemDesc: Guide on the new SIG quotation and billing workflow.
Ayuda.supportDesc: Our technical team is available Monday to Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Ayuda.reportBugDesc: If you find an error in the system, please notify the development team.
Ayuda.faq1a: We have simplified the process. Now all quotations, whether Time and Materials (TS) or Monthly Services (MS), are automatically generated with the unique prefix 'SIG' followed by a consecutive number (e.g. SIG-1024) for easier tracking.
Ayuda.faq2q: Can I edit a quotation that has already been sent?
Ayuda.faq2a: If the quotation is in 'Draft' status, you can edit it freely. If it has been marked as 'Accepted' or 'Rejected', the system blocks editing to protect the history. In that case, we recommend creating a new one.
Ayuda.faq3q: What should I do if I can't find a client in the search?
Ayuda.faq3a: You can add them directly from the 'New Quotation' screen. In the clients dropdown, select the 'Add new client' option at the end of the list and enter their tax details.
Ayuda.faq4q: How do I register a Purchase Order (PO)?
Ayuda.faq4a: Enter the quotation details (eye icon). If you change the status to 'Accepted' (Won), a green panel will appear where you can capture the PO number and update its administrative status.

rec.intro: What to review before approving the compared BOM. None of this is applied automatically: Engineering decides each point.

pnCambiado.title: Confirm {count, plural, one {# part number substitution} other {# part number substitutions}}
pnCambiado.text: The part number changed in the same position. Check in the Part Master that the new part replaces the old one and since when.

sustitucion.title: {count, plural, one {# possible substitution} other {# possible substitutions}}
sustitucion.text: In the same SC one part left and another with the same description came in. The BOM has no positions, so this cannot be confirmed: check with Engineering whether it is a replacement or two different parts.

cambioSc.title: {count, plural, one {# part moved} other {# parts moved}} to another SC
cambioSc.text: The same part number left one Structural Component and appears in another. Confirm it is a reassignment and not a data-entry error.

retiradas.title: Confirm {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} removed
retiradas.text: They are in the base and not in the compared BOM. Matrices are not purely cumulative, so confirm with Engineering that it is a removal and not an omission.

unidad.title: Check the unit of {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}
unidad.text: The same part changed its unit of measure. If not fixed, the ordered quantity may be wrong (for example, PC vs SET).

cantidad.title: Verify {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} with another quantity
cantidad.text: Compare them with what is installed on the machine before accepting the change.

descripcion.title: Unify the description of {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}
descripcion.text: The same part number has another description. Decide the canonical one in the Part Master. Differences only in case, spaces or punctuation are not counted.

nuevas.title: Complete {count, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}} added
nuevas.text: Assign their base interval and check that they have a price and are in the catalog.

duplicados.title: {count, plural, one {# repeated key} other {# repeated keys}} in the compared BOM
duplicados.text: The same SC and part number appears more than once. Nothing was removed: check whether they are different applications or an error. Keys not repeated in the base come first.

sinPosicion.title: The BOM has no positions
sinPosicion.text: Parts were paired by SC + part number. Without positions, a substitution shows as a removed part and a new part, so they are listed as possible substitutions.

aleman.title: {count, plural, one {# description} other {# descriptions}} with German terms
aleman.text: For example FUER, KLEMMRING or VENTIL. Translate them when defining the canonical description.

sinCambios.title: No changes
sinCambios.text: Both BOMs have the same parts, quantities and descriptions.
